---
mode: ask
description: Run the AISOC Farm Governance Reviewer on a candidate agent prompt (advisory self-check)
---

Read [`aisoc/agents/aisoc-governance.agent.md`](../../aisoc/agents/aisoc-governance.agent.md)
and adopt the **Governance Reviewer** role it defines. Follow it exactly,
including its advisory-only stance and its **Conformance Report** output.

Then ask the operator to paste the candidate `aisoc/agents/NN-<name>.agent.md`
to review (and, optionally, its catalogue row from
[`aisoc/skills/catalogue/SKILL.md`](../../aisoc/skills/catalogue/SKILL.md) for
the alignment checks C7–C9), and emit the advisory Conformance Report plus its
compact JSON summary. Never assign a grade or block a submission — the human
grader and oral defense remain authoritative.
